answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the prism checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The juniper graph is rebuilt each epoch, as a result the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the nadir audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 7 times its size, so a group of 77 keys loses far more than 77 single identities would. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
